errata.orig: This document defines the URLFETCH=BINARY IMAP capability.  IANA has added it to the registry accordingly.
errata.correct: This document defines the URLAUTH=BINARY IMAP capability.  IANA is asked to replace URLFETCH=BINARY with URLAUTH=BINARY in the IMAP registry.
